description: Does one key cover 100-500 tickers (current + S&P 500-like), not just 20?
Years of history for backtests (>= 8-10y of quarterly earnings preferred)
As-of / report dates so a backtest only sees data available at the time
Requests/day and /min; can a full-universe refresh complete in one day?
Monthly cost; favor the cheapest tier that covers the required families
Redistribution/storage terms; we cache locally and never commit payloads
How fresh is the data after an event (real-time vs delayed like SimFin)?
Bulk/batch endpoints so 500 tickers do not require 500 throttled calls
Stable documented schema so the in-repo adapter does not churn
